scope: University of Cape Town Health Sciences — MBChB programme addition

verifiedFacts.claim: UCT Faculty of Health Sciences describes MBChB as a six-year undergraduate programme and its 2027 applications open 1 April 2026 and close 31 July 2026.
UCT publishes minimum school-subject percentages, APS 450 and National Benchmark Test requirements for the six-year MBChB.
UCT Medicine teaching identifies clinical learning across Groote Schuur, Mitchells Plain, New Somerset, Victoria and George hospitals, including supervised ward and ambulatory care in years 4 and 6.
UCT says MBChB graduates require two years of internship and one year of community service before independent practice under HPCSA.
